blocks: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially released the Top 10 OBC-NCL Category Toppers List along with the Re-NEET UG 2026 Results. The merit list showcases the highest-performing candidates from the Other Backward Classes – Non-Creamy Layer (OBC-NCL) category, featuring students from Maharashtra, Bihar, Rajasthan, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu.

Topping the OBC-NCL merit list is Kudale Shravani Krishna from Maharashtra, who secured an impressive All India Rank (AIR) 5 with a 99.99965 percentile, making her not only the highest-ranked OBC-NCL candidate but also the highest-ranked female candidate in Re-NEET UG 2026.
Top 10 OBC-NCL Category Toppers – NEET UG 2026
Kudale Shravani Krishna Tops the OBC-NCL Merit List
Kudale Shravani Krishna from Maharashtra emerged as the highest-ranked OBC-NCL candidate in the country by securing AIR 5.
Her achievement is particularly noteworthy as she also became the highest-ranked female candidate in Re-NEET UG 2026.
Key Highlights from the OBC-NCL Merit List
Kudale Shravani Krishna (Maharashtra) secured AIR 5 and topped the OBC-NCL category.
Riya Ranjan (Bihar) finished second in the category with AIR 6.
